entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: ...Ever since the death of their teenage[n]leader, the Phantom Thieves have fallen[n]silent.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: However, the police intend on continuing[n]this investigation until the case is fully[n]solved.
entries.uk: Проте поліція має намір продовжувати[n]розслідування, доки справу не буде[n]остаточно розкрито.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I'm sorry I'm late. I had to finish a few[n]things at work. Where are they?
entries.uk: Вибачте, що запізнилася. Мусила закінчити[n]кілька справ на роботі. Де вони?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Waiting upstairs. Go tell them to come[n]on down.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I'm gonna fetch him.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You're... her sister, correct?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Makoto told me everything.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Futaba-chan... I'm sorry that I caused you[n]so much trouble this past summer...
entries.uk: Футабо... Мені шкода, що я завдала[n]тобі стільки клопоту минулого літа...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Eh, it's ancient history now.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But man, that goddamn detective!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Look who's here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, you big bastard!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: How've you been?
Pretty good.
I mean, I died...
Ghostly.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Thank goodness.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You must be fine if you're joking around[n]like that.
entries.uk: З тобою, мабуть, усе гаразд, раз ти отак[n]жартуєш.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You're not floating...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It truly is a relief to see your face.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I bet that moron Akechi don't even know[n]we tricked him yet!
entries.uk: Б'юся об заклад, той дурень Акечі навіть[n]не знає, що ми його обдурили!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Still, how'd you pull this off?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Isn't this guy considered dead?
entries.uk: Хіба цей хлопець не вважається мертвим?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You weren't told anything?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I heard my sister brought him here[n]though...
entries.uk: Я чула, що сестра його сюди[n]привезла...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Yeah. She came over in a taxi, dumped[n]him off, and told me to keep him safe.
entries.uk: Ага. Приїхала на таксі, висадила[n]його й сказала берегти.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: It was right after they announced he had[n]"died," too. Almost gave me a heart attack.
entries.uk: І це одразу після того, як оголосили, що він[n]«помер». Мене мало грець не вхопив.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I didn't have time to explain...
entries.uk: У мене не було часу пояснювати...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, shouldn't we tell Boss what really[n]happened?
entries.uk: Гей, може, розповімо Шефові, що[n]насправді сталося?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We wanted to make our enemy believe[n]the leader of the Phantom Thieves was[n]dead.
entries.uk: Ми хотіли, щоб ворог повірив,[n]що лідер Фантомних Злодіїв[n]мертвий.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What we did was make that enemy[n]kill his fake in the Metaverse.
entries.uk: Ми змусили ворога[n]вбити його двійника в Метавсесвіті.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: H-Hold on a sec!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Enemy? Fake? What're you talking about?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The true culprit behind all these incidents[n]set us up. Our goal here was to determine[n]their identity.
entries.uk: Справжній винуватець усіх цих інцидентів[n]нас підставив. Наша мета була з'ясувати,[n]хто він.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: True culprit?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I see... So you guys were going up against[n]someone else.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: It was Goro Akechi.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: You knew beforehand that he was the[n]traitor, didn't you?
entries.uk: Ви заздалегідь знали, що він[n]зрадник, так?

entries.en: Yes.
He was too suspicious.
Akechi messed up.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Akechi himself gave us the chance to[n]strike back.
entries.uk: Акечі сам дав нам шанс[n]завдати удару у відповідь.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He made one fatal mistake.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Couldn't you have just said from the[n]beginning that Akechi was the real[n]culprit?
entries.uk: Хіба не можна було з самого[n]початку сказати, що Акечі — справжній[n]винуватець?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That wasn't something we could simply[n]bring up.
entries.uk: Про таке не можна було просто[n]взяти й сказати.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We couldn't have you suspect Akechi.
entries.uk: Не можна було, щоб ви запідозрили Акечі.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Besides, neither you nor the other[n]investigators would have believed[n]something like that, would you?
entries.uk: До того ж ні ви, ні інші[n]слідчі не повірили б[n]у таке, правда?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...True.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Akechi was credited with the arrest of[n]the Phantom Thieves. Not even I would[n]think he was the culprit...
entries.uk: Арешт Фантомних Злодіїв приписали[n]Акечі. Навіть я не подумала б,[n]що він винуватець...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: In other words, you left him alone[n]on purpose... That was a bold move.
entries.uk: Інакше кажучи, ви навмисно[n]дали йому волю... Сміливий хід.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: God, I can't keep up with any of[n]this stuff...
entries.uk: Боже, я не встигаю за всім[n]цим...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Uhhh, so what was this mistake Akechi[n]made? What did he do?
entries.uk: Е-е, то яку помилку зробив[n]Акечі? Що він накоїв?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He slipped up in regards to Morgana's[n]voice.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You mean our cat?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yes. Morgana can talk.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Sorry, was that supposed to be a joke?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh! Our apologies. That's completely[n]true.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You surprised?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Does that mean... he said something[n]just now as well?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But you don't understand him, do you?[n]That's how it was for all of us at first too.
entries.uk: Але ви його не розумієте, так?[n]Спершу в усіх нас так само було.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: When you're in the Metaverse, Mona talks[n]like a normal person.
entries.uk: У Метавсесвіті Мона говорить[n]як звичайна людина.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Once you hear that and your brain[n]realizes he can actually talk, you start[n]to understand him in reality.
entries.uk: Щойно ти це почуєш і мозок усвідомить,[n]що він уміє говорити, ти починаєш[n]розуміти його й у реальності.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...It's a change in cognition! Most likely!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Thanks to Akechi's lame acting,[n]we figured out something was up.
entries.uk: Завдяки кульгавій грі Акечі[n]ми зрозуміли, що щось не так.
